name: metamodel.changeRelationKind
title: Change relation kind
summary: Change the name, inverse name, description, source and target types, limits or meaning of a relation kind; only the metamodel file that has it changes, line by line.
details: Each given field replaces the line of that field in the relation kind's definition, in the file it is in (SR-236 AK3, AK4); a missing field line is added after the definition's last line, and null removes it (for `sourceTypes` and `targetTypes`: every type; for `limits`: any number). A field that already has the value is left as it is. Every other line stays as it was; no element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036), and the key stays (D-043). Every field changes at any time (SR-239 AK2): relations that the new types no longer allow, or that break a new limit, stay in the element files as they are, and the check of the workspace reports them (`relation.not-allowed`, `relation.too-many`, `relation.too-few`; SR-086, SR-152). The metamodel files are read again before the change, and the metamodel afterwards is checked as a read would check it: an error refuses the command, warnings are in `problems` (SR-236 AK1). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no relation kind has the key (details.relationKind); input.invalid with details.reason taken when another relation kind has the name, in Unicode normal form NFC (details.field, details.relationKind); input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error (such as an unknown type or two limits for the same pair of types); workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when the definition or a node on the way to it is an alias or has an anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed the file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).

kind.description: Key of the relation kind to change.

name.description: New display name; no other relation kind may have it.

inverseName.description: New name shown at the target (`inverse-name`); null removes it.

description.description: New description, for people; null removes it.

sourceTypes.description: New keys of the types whose elements may be the source (`source-types`); a type also allows the types that extend it (SR-012 AK2). null: every type.

targetTypes.description: New keys of the types whose elements may be the target (`target-types`); a type also allows the types that extend it (SR-012 AK2). null: every type.

limits.description: New limits, the whole list, written as in the metamodel file (SR-152); null: any number.

meaning.description: New built-in meaning (D-012), one of `relationMeaning` of metamodel.schema.json; null removes it.

relationKind.title: Relation kind
relationKind.description: The definition as it is written afterwards.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

versionsChanged.title: Versions changed
versionsChanged.description: Elements whose version is another under the new metamodel (SR-015 AK4). A relation kind is no definition the version is computed from (ADR-0005), so this is 0; those of `versionsChangedElements`.

missingRequired.title: Missing required properties
missingRequired.description: Elements that now miss a value of a required property they did not miss before (SR-015 AK3); those of `missingRequiredElements`.

versionsChangedElements.title: Elements with another version
versionsChangedElements.description: The elements `versionsChanged` counts, in store order.

missingRequiredElements.title: Elements missing a required property
missingRequiredElements.description: The elements `missingRequired` counts, in store order.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The warnings of the metamodel afterwards (SR-236 AK1).
